core: BH3-only protein activation of BAX/BAK at mitochondria
name: NOXA/PUMA/BAD-driven BAX/BAK activation and cytochrome c release
rationale: All members concern BH3-only proteins (NOXA, PUMA, BAD) inactivating anti-apoptotic BCL-2 members and activating BAX/BAK to release cytochrome c, unlike confusables centred on apoptosome/SMAC, p53 transcription or BIM/BMF/BID.

name: Hypoxia/HIF and p53 control of glycolytic flux
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate and lactate metabolism together with HIF, oxygen homeostasis, p53 and mTORC1 regulators of it, whereas confusables emphasise FOXO/AKT, NRF2 or plain glucose catabolism.

name: Regulation of JNK and p38 stress-activated kinase cascades
rationale: Every member is positive or negative regulation or TAK1-mediated activation of JNK and p38 stress kinases, distinguishing it from ERK feedback, AP-1/NR4A and NOD-receptor confusables.

core: ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and lysosomal sorting
name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of ERBB-family receptors
rationale: Members describe ubiquitin-dependent internalisation and MVB/lysosomal sorting that terminates EGFR/ERBB2-4 signaling, unlike confusables about ESCRT/exosome machinery, AKT/PTEN, or MET/PTK6 signaling.

name: Regulation of NOD1/NOD2 receptor signaling
rationale: All three members are NOD1, NOD2 or NLR receptor signaling regulation terms, while confusables cover peptide transport, TLR/cytokine production, NF-kB/IKK or broader antibacterial NOD responses.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion organizers (neurexins, neuroligins, SALMs, RPTPs)
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion-driven pre- and postsynaptic assembly
rationale: Members cover pre- and postsynaptic membrane assembly, receptor and PSD-95 clustering driven by neurexin/neuroligin, SALM and RPTP adhesion complexes, unlike confusables focused on inhibitory/GABA synapses or neuronal cell adhesion.

name: Osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption
rationale: All members regulate osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion or bone resorption/remodeling, distinct from macrophage/CSF1 and osteoblast confusables.

name: Alditol (polyol) and fructose metabolism
rationale: Members are alditol biosynthesis and catabolism plus fructose metabolism (the polyol route), unlike confusables on pentose/xylulose, glycerolipid or gluconeogenic metabolism.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All three members are CCT/TRiC chaperonin actions on nascent actin, tubulin and other targets, distinct from aggrephagy and general/ER folding confusables.

name: Insulin-stimulated GLUT4 translocation and glucose import
rationale: Members concern insulin-driven GLUT4/RHOQ trafficking to the membrane, glucose import and insulin/insulin receptor handling, unlike confusables about adiponectin signaling, IRS/AKT2 signaling or fatty acid uptake.

core: regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
qualifier: costimulation, anergy and dendritic cell differentiation
name: T cell activation-tolerance balance and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate T cell costimulation, proliferation, anergy, Treg/Th1/Th17 balance and cytokine output together with dendritic cell differentiation, which the T-cell-only and NK/cytotoxicity confusables lack.

name: Tangential migration of forebrain GABAergic interneurons
rationale: Members describe tangential migration of cortical GABAergic and olfactory bulb interneuron precursors with cortical regionalization, unlike confusables on radial glia-guided migration, layering and commissures.

name: Neurotrophin TRK signaling, chiefly BDNF/NT-3 via TRKB and TRKC
rationale: All members are neurotrophin-TRK signaling and its downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5 and CREB arms, with NTRK2/NTRK3 branches that the NGF/TRKA and p75NTR confusables lack.

name: Restraint of type 2 cytokine and IgE responses
rationale: Members concern limiting IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 and immunoglobulin production with IgE switching and mast cell cytokines, whereas confusables cover positive Th2 differentiation, IL-4/13/33 signaling or eosinophils.

qualifier: autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosome fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome formation and maturation and late endosome/MVB/autophagosome fusion with lysosomes, unlike confusables on selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy) or phagosome fusion.

qualifier: ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and homeostasis
name: Ceramide and sphingomyelin metabolism and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingoid/ceramide synthesis, sphingomyelin synthesis, sphingolipid catabolism and homeostasis, unlike confusables on glycosphingolipids, lipid transfer or TNFR1 ceramide signaling.

core: endosomal recycling and Golgi membrane traffic
name: ARF/Rab-regulated endosomal recycling and Golgi traffic
rationale: Members combine ARF and Rab/TBC GAP signaling with endosome tubulation, receptor recycling and Golgi budding/secretion, which the more generic trafficking confusables lack.

name: cAMP-PKA and calcium-CaMK signaling to CREB
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase/PKA and CaMKK/CaMKIV/AMPK cascades converging on CREB phosphorylation and postsynapse-to-nucleus signaling, unlike memory/plasticity, MECP2 or dopamine receptor confusables.

qualifier: Hedgehog and planar cell polarity signaling
name: Hedgehog and planar polarity signaling in gastrulation and neurulation
rationale: Members combine Hedgehog/GLI and PCP/non-canonical Wnt signaling with convergent extension, axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate morphogenesis, while confusables lack Hedgehog and cover Wnt-calcium, anteroposterior/dorsoventral or left-right patterning.

qualifier: retina, optic cup and optic nerve
name: Eye morphogenesis emphasising retina, optic cup and optic nerve
rationale: Members cover optic cup, retinal layering and cell differentiation, optic nerve and RGC axons plus iris, eyelid and pigmentation, unlike lens/cornea, inner ear or photoreceptor-maturation confusables.

name: ESCRT-mediated membrane scission in viral budding and exosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are ESCRT machinery acts (MVB formation, viral/HIV budding, exosome assembly, nuclear envelope sealing), unlike confusables on cytokinetic abscission, receptor downregulation or autophagy.

name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: All members are Hippo pathway signaling and its regulation plus detection of cell density, distinct from the adherens junction and polarity confusables.

qualifier: PSD maintenance, receptor recycling and local translation
name: Postsynaptic structure maintenance and long-term synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern postsynapse assembly, PSD and actin maintenance, receptor delivery from endosomes and synaptic translation supporting long-term plasticity, unlike dendrite arborization and spine morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: poly-ADP-ribosylation, fork reversal and DNA topology
name: Poly-ADP-ribosylation and replication fork stress in genotoxic responses
rationale: Members cover ADP-ribosylation, fork reversal, DNA topological change, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to replication-blocking drugs, unlike double-strand break and homologous recombination confusables.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine synthesis and mitochondrial nucleotide transport
name: Tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and mitochondrial nucleotide transport
rationale: Members are tryptophan/kynurenine catabolism to quinolinate and NAD+, NAD(P) salvage and NAD/ADP/ATP mitochondrial transport, whereas confusables centre on coenzyme A, creatine or polyamine metabolism.
